mission_title: Notification preferences and bounded delivery reliability
scenario: A fictional regulated service requires explicit notification preferences, bounded retry and traceable delivery outcomes. Produce an architecture assessment of the supplied fictional owner repositories without claiming real runtime proof.

sources.text: Mission NOTIFY-01 covers notification preference management. Canonical repo lab/notification-api owns REST user preferences and opt-out enforcement. Current documentation describes GET and PATCH preferences but lacks a consent revocation acceptance test. No production evidence was supplied.

Mission NOTIFY-01 requires bounded asynchronous delivery. Canonical repo lab/event-relay owns delivery queue consumers, deduplication keys and delivery status events. Current documentation describes retry without an explicit maximum; dead-letter handling is a proposed design, not deployed. There is no measured RTO or production runtime proof.
